description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 14.08.2017 to 20.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and contains regulatory content about customs duties and exchange rates. It establishes new rates of exchange for customs calculations and rescinds a previous notification, making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel, organisational, or other specialized type.
